title: Warm Springy French Lentil Salad
description: A hearty and refreshing French-inspired salad featuring lentils and nuka-pickle, perfect for a post-workout meal. This dish is Whole30-friendly and showcases the flavors of Alsace.

ingredients.name: French lentils
ingredients.notes: green or brown lentils work well

instructions: Rinse the lentils and cook them in 2 cups of water until they are tender, about 20 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the apple cider vinegar, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped nuka-pickle, sliced red onion, grated carrots, and sliced celery to the bowl and toss to combine.
Once the lentils are cooked, drain and add them to the bowl, tossing to combine with the dressing and vegetables.
Let the salad sit at room temperature for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve the salad warm, garnished with additional chopped nuka-pickle if desired.
This salad can be made ahead of time and refrigerated for up to 24 hours.
Before serving, let the salad come to room temperature or warm it gently in the oven.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed before serving.
